limitations: Shifted families on exactly 7 vertices only; not all tight-5-cycle-free 3-graphs.
No upper bound on the unrestricted tight-5-cycle Turán density is claimed.
Isomorphism grouping is computational (all vertex permutations plus canonical forms), not structural.
Machine-exhaustion proof with replayable certificates, not a proof-assistant certificate.
provenance: Previously published finding; fresh independent assessment completed on 2026-09-30 UTC.
